replies.body: Hello, Greetings from The Architect's Diary! Our happiest and warmest wishes to you and your team on this festival of lights! May this Diwali open doors to exciting projects and more collaborations with TAD! We are currently out of the office from November 6th to November 15th, 2026 , and there may be a slight delay in our response. Rest assured, your emails are important to us and will be prioritised upon our return. If you require immediate attention, please contact me on the number below. Regards, Poojaba Vaghela 88666 01716 The Architect's Diary www.thearchitectsdiary.com Facebook Youtube Instagram Pinterest
